meta.description: A Roon Core in Home Assistant: every Roon zone becomes a media player through the core roon integration, with play and pause, seek, shuffle, repeat, grouping, transfer and Roon's own library to browse. For a zone whose amplifier Roon cannot control, Roon's volume buttons turn that amplifier's volume through Home Assistant.

roon-core.description: The server that runs Roon: ROCK on an Intel NUC, a Nucleus, or Roon Server on a computer or NAS. It holds the library and sends music to the zones.
roon-core.does: Through the core roon integration, Home Assistant sees each Roon zone as a media player, controls playback and volume, moves the queue between zones and groups them. Nothing leaves the home network.

explain.title: About Roon
explain.description: Roon gives each zone of a Roon Core a media player in Home Assistant and can pass Roon's volume buttons to an amplifier; installed metadata does not say what is playing.
